diversity_definition: mean pairwise Euclidean distance between a list's tracks in the 9 audio features, each z-scored over the catalog (feature-space diversity, not perceived diversity)

strategy_definitions.A: production: recommend._sample_best: weighted sample, w = s - min(pool s) + 1e-6
strategy_definitions.B: uniform: uniform sample without replacement from the same pool
strategy_definitions.C: mmr: greedy MMR in the pool; relevance = min-max signal over the pool; redundancy = max over chosen of 1 - d / d_ref, d_ref = 2 x max distance to the pool centroid; first pick production-weighted
strategy_definitions.C': mmr_sub: MMR on a production-weighted random sub-pool of 3 x share
strategy_definitions.D: stratified k-means: k-means (k = share, n_init=1, seeded) on the pool; one production-weighted pick per cluster
strategy_definitions.shared: all strategies keep eligibility, exact per-target shares, the top pool_multiplier x share pool and production's interleaving

selection_rule.objective: maximize mean diversity over the single-target requests (exploratory seeds)

signal.kind: derived percentile score, stored rounded to 6 dp

post_hoc_held_out.note: post hoc robustness check on the held-out seeds; not part of the selection rule

notes: Precision/NDCG are omitted: relevance is the eligibility definition itself, so they are 1.0 for every strategy here and cannot rank strategies.
mean_ranking_signal_of_served is the classifier probability (label targets) or derived score (angry/stressed): the ranking's own signal, not an independent quality measure.

Bootstrap intervals resample the runs of one request; runs share the same candidate pool, so they describe sampling variability only, not variation across users or catalogs. No significance is claimed.
Latency is the whole replica call in this harness on this machine.
